description: Network Flow: Power, Current and Embedded Generation is a dataset listed in SP Energy Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity network operator, published or maintained by SP Energy Networks. The " Network Flow: Power, Current and Embedded Generation " data table details historically measured average and reactive power flows, current and provides indicative demand/generation output for each Grid and Primary network group for our SP Manweb (SPM) and SP Distribution (SPD) licence areas, for each half-hourly period. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Operational Data. Its keywords are Active Power, Current, Reactive Power, Power, Generation, HV. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-spen-open-data-portal.
